summary: Iter 85 — Verified new employee-kiosk 'Bonnen van vandaag' green dot + overlay flow end-to-end against the preview URL, plus admin regression. Setup: admin login → PUT /api/employees/{anita_id} reseed app_role=kiosk + PIN 4321 → POST /api/auth/kiosk-pin returned kiosk_token → inserted a TEST approved kiosk payment for Anita today in mongo → POST /api/kiosk/printers/register returned device_token → ran a background Python websockets client at wss://.../api/kiosk/ws authed role=printer which replies REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ok on each REMOTE_PRINT. Playwright at 390x844 (iPhone), kiosk_token in localStorage (NO admin_token): (1) data-testid=kiosk-employee-receipts-dot renders with data-active=true (WS connected), kiosk-presence-dot is NOT present. (2) Overlay does NOT auto-open. (3) Clicking the dot opens kiosk-prints-overlay; employee picker lists both Anitas (one is stale from an earlier DB reset — harmless), picking the current Anita by kiosk-prints-employee-{id} shows the test receipt row kiosk-print-log-{payment_id}. (4) In employee mode there is NO kiosk-prints-approve-all, NO kiosk-print-log-approve-*, NO kiosk-print-log-remove-*. kiosk-print-log-ktp-{id} (Print via KT-V520) and kiosk-print-log-print-{id} (Afdrukken) are present. (5) KT-V520 button becomes enabled after GET /api/kiosk/printers/online (fetchPrinters=true path in KtpPrintButton) returns the online printer. Clicking it triggers backend POST .../remote-print → backend sends REMOTE_PRINT via WS to the printer, printer replies REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ok → UI shows kiosk-print-log-ktp-status-{id} 'Geprint op TEST_Iter85 KT-V520' and the row is marked Afgedrukt (kiosk-print-log-done-{id} visible). (6) kiosk-prints-close hides the overlay. Admin regression (1280x900, admin_token present): kiosk-presence-dot renders, kiosk-employee-receipts-dot is absent, overlay opens with the row, and the admin remove button kiosk-print-log-remove-{payment_id} is shown for the done row (approve-all/approve not applicable because payment was created with status=approved, not pending_approval — behavior consistent with existing code). All 16 employee assertions + all 6 admin assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: KioskPrintsOverlay employee picker can show duplicate 'Anita Sewdas' entries when the preview DB reset re-creates employees with new IDs but old payments retain their original kiosk_employee_id — picker groups strictly by key (employee id). Not a bug introduced by this change (same behavior in admin mode), but a mild UX nit worth noting: an older-day's offline employee with the same display name as a current one shows twice.

KtpPrintButton.jsx polls /api/kiosk/printers/online every 15s when fetchPrinters=true. Overlay instantiates a KtpPrintButton PER row, so each row polls independently (N rows → N requests every 15s). Consider lifting the fetch to the parent overlay and sharing via context/prop to avoid N× network traffic as print-log grows.

KioskLiveStatus employee branch mounts KioskPrintsOverlay inline (not lazy) → bundles OverlayPickers/KtpPrintButton even for employees who never open the dot. Minor perf nit; could lazy-load the overlay the same way ApprovePaymentSheet is lazy-loaded inside it.

KioskPrintsOverlay useEffect dependency arrays use `eslint-disable` because load/loadEmps aren't memoized against `emp?.key` — the eslint disable is intentional but makes the data-flow harder to review; wrapping emp in useMemo (keyed by key) would remove the suppression.
